title: M4TR!X ACTIVE_TASK.evidence
description: Evidence object convention for task completion claims. When the key is present it must match this shape. When status/phase is done or accepted, evidence must be present and non-empty (at least one command or artifact).

commands.description: Commands that were actually run (with enough detail to reproduce).

artifacts.description: Paths or URIs to logs, JSON samples, screenshots, etc.

recordedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when evidence was last recorded.
